newsitem.title: UK: Chesterfield buys Manchester Ramada hotel.
newsitem.headline: Chesterfield buys Manchester Ramada hotel.

text.p: Chesterfield Properties Plc said on Wednesday that it had acquired a long lease of the Ramada Hotel complex in Manchester from P&O Property Holdings for 9.6 million stg.
The complex includes the 205 bedroom Ramada Hotel, 2,600 square metres of offices and 1,033 square metres of retail and leisure uses.
Rent for the whole complex is currently 1.05 million stg, showing an initial yield of 10.64 percent.
"Opportunity exists for rent increase and the bringing into use of existing and new space with greater income potential," Chesterfield said.
Manchester City Council is the freeholder.
